messages:
maria: Report from the external pen-test just landed (attached). We need a short remediation sweep + retest orchestration. High-level asks: 1) a timeboxed RBAC change to grant assessor access for exports 2) KMS envelope/key questions — can we provide temporary decrypt or should we provide encrypted exports + data-key generation? 3) audit/export retention and chain-of-custody. Proposing a window: Thu 2025-06-12 09:00-11:00 UTC. cc @lee @oliver @sam — who can own ops & SRE during the window?
lee: I can own ops for the window but need on-call SRE to sign off on egress for presigned links. @oliver?
oliver: I can be oncall. Quick notes: prefer ephemeral roles and generated data-keys rather than handing out raw keys. If testers need to decrypt locally, we can provide DataKey + encrypted payload, not Decrypt on persistent keys.
sam: Agree. For KMS pattern I'd recommend envelope encryption + GenerateDataKeyForDecrypt for ephemeral role, then audit only on KMS:Decrypt calls. We should avoid granting kms:Decrypt directly to external principals.
remediation-bot: Assigned REM-452 to ops and security for coordination. Due date placeholder 2025-06-16.
kyle: Started a branch with an RBAC shim for assessor access. PR #874 adds a temporal role 'pt_assessor' scoped to logs/read and export:create with a TTL of 2 hours. Policy snippet in the branch:
```
{
  "Action": ["logs:Read","exports:Create"],
  "Resource": ["arn:redwood:logs:*"] ,
  "Condition": {"DateLessThan": {"aws:TokenIssueTime": "2025-06-12T11:00:00Z"}}
}
```
maria: Nice. Two operational asks: 1) we need an export snapshot for the testers with 90-day retention and a manifest describing included artifacts; 2) pre-signed urls should be single-use and TTL'd to the assessor window. Also attach the small eval prompt set we used so they can reproduce the regression cases. Link will be in the doc.
lee: I can run the export via staging first. Command I'll run: `./scripts/export_logs.sh --from 2025-05-01 --to 2025-06-11 --key pt-2025-06-12` — but I'll need a KMS grant that allows GenerateDataKey only for the pt_assessor role. Do we have a grant flow documented?
oliver: We have a KMS grant automation but it's currently for internal services. For this flow we can: 1) create ephemeral IAM role 2) create a KMS grant with operations: Encrypt, GenerateDataKey, RevokeGrant 3) rotate/revoke grant after window. Example assume command for role: 
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt_assessor --duration-seconds 7200
```
sam: I'll prepare the grant automation changes. Also confirm: audit sampling for the PT window should be 100% for auth and kms events. I'll enable extended retention for the `pt-evidence` bucket and tag exports with `pt-id=REM-452`.
maria: Retest schedule: propose retest slot Mon 2025-06-16 14:00-16:00 UTC. Can people confirm availability?
lee: Confirmed for ops.
kyle: Confirmed for dev side. I'll keep the PR unmerged until after dry-run.
oliver: Operational packaging checklist (my proposal): manifest.json, signed hash (SHA256), pre-signed URLs (single-use), ephemeral-roles.csv, and an evidence-readme.md with step-by-step assume/validate. I will also enable S3 object-lock on the export objects if available.
maria: Good checklist. We'll require that manifest.json include a chain-of-custody field with actor/time and the KMS key-id used.
lee: On rollback: if anything suspicious we drop the pt_assessor role, revoke KMS grant, rotate the CMK's grant policy, and purge pre-signed urls. I'll add an automated job to revoke grants on fail.
sam: Added runbook steps to the security runbook repo: /docs/runbooks/pt_exports_and_assume.md. It includes commands for grant creation, role assumption, and revocation.
maria: Let's do a dry-run Fri 2025-06-13 10:00 UTC to validate role assumption, export creation, manifest generation, and audit logs. Meeting invite incoming. We'll keep access locked until dry-run passes. @security-oncall FYI.
security-oncall: ack — will shadow the dry-run and watch CloudTrail + internal API auth logs.
lee: Quick gotcha I caught: our current presign utility doesn't enforce single-use. I'll patch it to generate a one-time token stored in Dynamo with TTL. Patch will be small, PR today.
kyle: I'll review that PR and update the export script to annotate the manifest with the token ID.
maria: Thanks all. After dry-run and a security review of PR #874 we'll open the real assessor window. If anything blocks, escalate to postmortems channel. :thumbsup:
lee: sounds good — will post logs and the export link in this thread after the dry-run.
remediation-bot: REM-452 status: in-progress (ops scheduled for dry-run 2025-06-13 10:00 UTC).
